vulnerabilities.description: Reporter Muneaki Nishimura Impact high Description Firefox for iOS directly interpolated the page’s HTML language attribute into translation JavaScript, allowing attacker-controlled markup to execute code in Firefox’s privileged content world and bypass the page’s Content Security Policy. References Bug 2062109

vulnerabilities.description: Reporter planctonone Impact moderate Description Firefox for iOS could autofill saved credentials into a new page if cross-origin navigation occurred while the saved-login UI was open. Autofill was not bound to the originating page or rejected when its origin changed. References Bug 2068171
